import ast
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from hashlib import sha256
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re

ROOT = Path.cwd()
OUT = ROOT / '.tmp/ex054-method-review'
BASE = ROOT / 'research/S013/experiments'
JSON_NAMES = {'metadata.json', 'plan.json', 'geometry.json', 'protocol.json', 'decision.json', 'authorization.json'}
MAX_JSON = 262144
EXACT = 'RAW_BEAR_TIME_BELOW_BODY'
PATTERN = re.compile(r'RAW_BEAR_TIME_BELOW_BODY|MEAN_BEAR_TIME_BELOW_BODY|RAW_BEAR_BODY|RAW_BEAR_TIME_BELOW_CLOSE|last_exit_category|direction_applies|signal_close\s*>\s*signal_open')


def digest(path):
    return sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def main():
    selected = sorted(p for p in BASE.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and
        (p.suffix in ('.py', '.md') or (p.name in JSON_NAMES and p.stat().st_size <= MAX_JSON)))
    inventory = [{'path':p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'bytes':p.stat().st_size,'sha256':digest(p)} for p in selected]
    hits, unique, legal_exact = [], {}, []
    for path in selected:
        text = path.read_text('utf-8-sig')
        matches = [{'line':i,'text':line.strip() if line.isascii() else '[non-ASCII text omitted; byte hash retained]'}
            for i,line in enumerate(text.splitlines(),1) if PATTERN.search(line)]
        if matches:
            hits.append({'path':path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'sha256':digest(path),'matches':matches})
        if '/strategy_runtime/strategies/' in path.as_posix() and path.suffix=='.py':
            unique.setdefault(digest(path),[]).append(path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix())
            tree=ast.parse(text)
            for cls in (n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,ast.ClassDef)):
                ctor=next((n for n in cls.body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=='__init__'),None)
                if ctor is None:
                    continue
                for node in ctor.body:
                    if not isinstance(node,ast.If) or not isinstance(node.test,ast.Compare):
                        continue
                    test=ast.unparse(node.test)
                    if 'mechanism' not in test or not any(isinstance(n,ast.Raise) for n in ast.walk(node)):
                        continue
                    allowed=[]
                    for comparator in node.test.comparators:
                        if isinstance(comparator,ast.Constant) and isinstance(comparator.value,str):
                            allowed.append(comparator.value)
                        elif isinstance(comparator,(ast.Tuple,ast.List,ast.Set)):
                            allowed.extend(n.value for n in comparator.elts if isinstance(n,ast.Constant) and isinstance(n.value,str))
                    # Existing sources reject when enum != accepted value or not in accepted tuple.
                    rejects_outside=any(isinstance(op,(ast.NotEq,ast.NotIn)) for op in node.test.ops)
                    if rejects_outside and EXACT in allowed:
                        legal_exact.append({'path':path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'class':cls.name,'accepted':allowed,'line':node.lineno})

def digest(path):
    return sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

    selected = sorted(p for p in BASE.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and

    inventory = [{'path':p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'bytes':p.stat().st_size,'sha256':digest(p)} for p in selected]
    hits, unique, legal_exact = [], {}, []
    for path in selected:
        text = path.read_text('utf-8-sig')
        matches = [{'line':i,'text':line.strip() if line.isascii() else '[non-ASCII text omitted; byte hash retained]'}
            for i,line in enumerate(text.splitlines(),1) if PATTERN.search(line)]

                    test=ast.unparse(node.test)
